entities.summary: Jesca Ababiku is a Ugandan educator and politician. She is currently a member of the eleventh Parliament of Uganda, representing the people of Adjumani district in one of the parliamentary seats reserved for women. Ababiku is a member of the National Resistance Movement and the Chairperson of the Presidential Affairs (NRM), the ruling political party in Uganda under the chairmanship of Yoweri Kaguta Museveni Tibuhaburwa, the current president of the Republic of Uganda. In the 2021 Uganda general elections, Ababiku retained her seat democratically for the third time as women member of parliament for Adjumani district since 2011.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Jesca Ababiku's election to the Ugandan Parliament for the third time in 2021 reflects a growing trend of women's representation in East African politics. Her role as Chairperson of the Presidential Affairs Committee underscores her influence within the National Resistance Movement.
